content: Sukkur Barrage ke gates khol diye gaye hain! Paani tezi se aa raha hai — Rohri side mein paani gharon mein ghus gaya. Log apna saman le ke bhaag rahe hain. #SukkurFlood #IndusRiver
Sukkur Barrage reading 850,000 cusecs! That's above high flood level. Rohri, Saleh Pat and downstream villages flooding fast. NDMA kahan hai? People need boats NOW. #SukkurBarrage
Sukkur mein aaj garmi ka record toot gaya — 50.1°C! Bijli nahi, paani nahi. Govt Hospital mein mareez bahar rakh diye hain. AC nahi chal raha. Doctors overwhelmed. #SukkurHeatwave

IRSA Sukkur Barrage Control Room: Discharge 847,000 cusecs — above HFL (High Flood Level 750,000 cusecs). 12 gates fully open. Downstream alert issued. Rohri embankment holding but Saleh Pat left bank showing seepage. 3 villages within 2km breach risk zone. NDMA activated.

Sukkur Government Hospital CMO: Hospital at 168% capacity — 284 patients in 169-bed facility. 47 heatstroke admissions since 11:00. 9 critical (core temp >41°C). Power outage since 12:30 — backup generator fuel critically low (2hr remaining). IV fluid stock at 18% — resupply urgent.

IRSA River Gauge Station SKR-RG01 (Sukkur Barrage): Water level 206.8ft (danger level 204ft, HFL 207.5ft). Rising 0.4ft/hr. Flow velocity 7.2m/s. Left bank embankment strain gauge: 82% of safe limit. Breach risk: HIGH if level exceeds 207.5ft within 90min.

Sindh Meteorological Office Sukkur Station SKR-MET01: Temperature 50.1°C (all-time station record). Heat index 58°C. Humidity 18%. Wind 3km/h — no cooling effect. UV index: EXTREME. Forecast: 49-51°C next 36 hours. Heat dome persistent.

Rescue 1122 Sindh Sukkur: 52 flood calls — 19 rooftop strandings, 6 livestock swept away, 27 evacuation requests from Rohri/Saleh Pat zone. 11 heatstroke emergency calls from city. 3 callers reporting unconscious family members in unventilated homes.

Rohri-Sukkur Bridge: 0km/h — emergency vehicle priority only. Saleh Pat Road: flooded, impassable. National Highway N-55: 12km/h — flood evacuee vehicles. Sukkur city centre: 8km/h — heat-related road closures.
